description: Pure-data description of a wireframe component's metadata. Contains everything an external consumer (API, MCP server, AI tooling) needs to understand what the component is and how to configure it — without any UI or rendering dependencies. Built-in schemas are provided by BuiltInComponentSchemas in this assembly. Custom schemas (e.g. from a database) can be supplied by implementing IWireframeSchemaSource and registering it in DI.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Unique type identifier. Matches WireframeElement.Type in document JSON. E.g. 'TmButton', 'TmDataTable'.

properties.name: DisplayName
properties.description: Human-readable component name shown in toolboxes and palettes.

properties.name: DefaultWidth
properties.description: Default element width when dropped onto the canvas. Defaults to 120.

properties.name: DefaultHeight
properties.description: Default element height when dropped onto the canvas. Defaults to 36.

properties.name: Props
properties.description: Property definitions that drive the Properties Panel UI and document serialisation. Each entry describes one key in WireframeElement.Props.

properties.name: SizePresets
properties.description: Optional map from a 'size' prop value to canonical element dimensions. Null for components where the size prop does not affect element footprint.
